final_text:
each item, calls inventory.release_reservation(sku, qty)
  - Sets order.status to cancelled

Files touched
- inventory.py
  - Implemented reservation model and updated available()
- orders.py
  - Implemented atomic reservation on create_order
  - Replaced direct remove_stock with reservation-to-deduction flow on fulfill
  - Releasing reservations on cancel
  - Import InsufficientStock

Behavior summary (new rules)
- Creating an order reserves stock
  - If any line cannot be reserved, InsufficientStock is raised and nothing is reserved or created
- Cancelling a pending order releases its reservation
- Fulfilling turns the reservation into an actual deduction
- Inventory.available(sku) = on-hand minus reserved
- Reports (low_stock, stock_value) continue to use on-hand (stock) quantities

How to verify (quick guide)
- Run tests (these reflect the updated semantics)
  - python -m unittest discover
  - Or run specific tests: python -m unittest tests.test_shop
- Expected behaviors
  - Creating an order reserves stock; fulfilling deducts from on-hand; available reflects remaining on-hand after reservations are released or deducted
  - Cancelling a pending order releases its reservation
  - Insufficient stock errors show available equal to on-hand minus reserved
  - Reports still reflect on-hand stock (not available)

If you want, I can run through a concrete in-repo scenario or adjust tests further to explicitly assert the reservation lifecycle (reserve -> cancel -> release, etc.).
